description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 3+1+2+depo ne fund te rruges 5 maji.
Organizohet nga 1 ambjent ndenje dhe gatimi bashke,3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete,1 depo, dhe 3 ballkone .
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati te ri (2023) me ashensor.
Prona disponon dokumentacion të rregullt hipotekor.
Mundesi blerje me kredi.
description_en: Apartment 3+1+2+storage for sale at the end of May 5 street. It is organized by 1 common living and cooking area, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, 1 storage room, and 3 balconies. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a new building (2023) with an elevator. The property has regular mortgage documentation. Possibility of purchase with credit.
